detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: Use static analysis to build a call graph from user code to all methods in third-party packages. Flag any path that leads to a method known to trigger a vulnerability (as identified by CVE analysis). Pay special attention to exported methods that act as bridges to vulnerable internal methods.
